name: Hitori ni Shinaide... I want to be together
original_name: 一人にしないで… I want to be together
source:
Main character is a freeter. He meets two boys in his casual everyday life. One lives in the neighborhood, and the other one is met by chance. Protagonist feels loneliness in their hearts and does not want to let them go.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名自由者。他在随意的日常生活中遇到了两个男孩。一个住在附近，另一个是偶然认识的。主角内心感到孤独，不想放开他们。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
